p: Let me now choose out twelve: The wicked are so greedy to execute their malice, that they leave no opportunity that may further the same.
the man whom thou seekest is: Meaning David.
good at this time: Hushai shows himself faithful to David, in that he reproves this wicked counsel and purpose.
good counsel of Ahithophel: That counsel which seemed good at first to Absalom, 2Sa 17:4.
bring evil upon Absalom: For by the counsel of Hushai, he went to the battle, where he was destroyed.
them: Meaning, the message from their fathers.
the woman took and spread a: Thus God sends help to his, in their greatest dangers.
brook of water: The Chaldee text reads: Now they have passed the Jordan.
thus hath Ahithophel counselled against you: That is, to pursue you with all haste.
by the morning light there lacked: They travelled all night, and by morning had all their company passed over.
hanged himself: God's just vengeance even in this life is poured on them who are enemies, traitors, or persecutors of his Church.
Nahash: Who was also called Jesse, David's father.
Brought beds: God shows himself most liberal to his, when they seem to be utterly destitute.
